domain.notes: Starter template — banking loan recovery, India (INR / DMY / PAN-Aadhaar-IFSC validators derive from country)

datasets.name: Payment disputes
datasets.description: Open dispute cases: the borrower claims a payment the system shows outstanding. The submitted receipt (receipt_url) is screened against collections.payments automatically. FULLY SCREENED dataset — applies:true + every artifact_role demonstrated.

columns.name: borrower_pan
columns.description: PAN — checksum-validated automatically under the IN locale pack

columns.name: receipt_url
columns.description: The submitted proof-of-payment document (receipt / UTR slip). ROLE payment_proof = pinned: ONLY this document feeds the ledger check, and the same receipt reused on another case is a fraud signal.

columns.name: id_scan_url
columns.description: Borrower's ID scan. ROLE identity = a resubmitted ID from the same person is VERIFICATION, never a duplicate-fraud flag — the false-alarm killer.

columns.name: supporting_doc_url
columns.description: Any other submitted document. ROLE evidence = screened for cross-case reuse, never matched against the ledger.

columns.name: tnc_ack_url
columns.description: Signed T&C acknowledgment. ROLE supporting = never fingerprinted at all (its reuse is meaningless).

datasets.name: Settled payments ledger
datasets.description: Settled customer payments, UTR-keyed — the system of record every submitted payment proof verifies against. This description is shown to the recommending AI; keep it specific. NOTE: no fraud_screening block at all — silence means the ledger itself is never screened; it is the verification TARGET.

datasets.name: Branch master
datasets.description: Reference table of branches. EXPLICIT OPT-OUT example — applies:false is a hard off: even if someone later adds artifact columns here, no screen is ever created and autowire CLEARS any hand-wired one.

sources.name: Credit bureau — score lookup (API-as-dataset)
sources.description: Live credit-bureau passthrough (CIBIL-style), exposed as a parameterised dataset: the app's agent reads it like any table, the MCP holds the corporate credentials and the audit trail. TEMPLATE — replace base_url/path/field mapping with the real bureau contract.

datasets.name: Credit score by PAN
datasets.description: Bureau credit report looked up by PAN. mandatory_when_used:true = the read-before-write gate REFUSES to stage a decision unless this lookup actually ran for the case. NOTE: a rest dataset is an agent-read lookup and registry-evidence source — it can NOT be a payment_proof/verify_against ledger target (the structured read-by-key plane covers sql/odata/soql/mongodb only).
